title: Projects Undertaken
text:
Object detection using DOTA dataset and training using YOLOV8
[View Document] (files/assignments/yolosummary.html) | View PPT

Detect objects such as airplanes in aerial images using the DOTA dataset and the YOLOv8s model.
A DOTA sub dataset selected converted from oriented bounding box (OBB) format to COCO format for compatibility with YOLOv8.
The YOLOv8 model trained on prepared dataset, preprocessed and added validation steps to improve detection performance.
The trained model detects objects in test images and the outputs visualized through an interactive Python-based interface.

Land Use Change Detection – Norcia, Italy
View document

Analyzed pre- and post-earthquake land patterns (2016 Italy earthquake).
Used remote sensing & GIS techniques for land-use classification.

title: About Me
text:
As a GIS scholar, currently I am pursuing my Master of Science in GIS at the University of Texas at Dallas, where I am deepening my expertise in geospatial modeling, data visualization and AI-driven GIS solutions.
Prior to this, I completed a Post Graduate Diploma in GIS from IUCGIST, India, where I gained expertise in spatial modeling, remote sensing, and GIS programming. My academic foundation includes a Master’s and Bachelor’s degree in Physics from the University of Kerala, which helped me develop strong analytical and scientific skills, now applied in my geospatial research.


My Interests & Expertise
I am particularly interested in how GIS, Python and Machine learning can be used to: - Analyze environmental changes (land use, climate impact and disaster risk assessment). - Develop interactive spatial visualizations for real-world geospatial problems. Apply machine learning to GIS for predictive analytics and classification.
My academic and professional journey has allowed me to work on several impactful projects, integrating Python, remote sensing techniques and statistical modeling to generate actionable insights from geospatial data.
